name: JEI Test Guide
landing_text: Welcome to the integration field guide. These notes cover materials, recipes, identifiers, and ordinary prose. Search Diamond to compare several chapter links; search Oak Planks, Iron Ingot, Redstone Dust, Torch, or Bread to test other references.$(br2)Each chapter mixes short labels with longer passages so the same book can exercise Patchouli page navigation and JEI item lookup.
